input: work/standalone/tools/sdlfeed.c (DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES into the ad-hoc-signed Homebrew binary): SDL key events synthesized inside the process on presented frames, from the retro-run script mapped to Mednafen's default keys (gen_sdlfeed.py); flip = F8 eject, F6 select disk side, F8 insert, 30 frames apart; F9 snapshot for shot, F10 reset, F12 exit (Mednafen writes saves on exit)

layout.name: <ROM file name without extension>.<MD5 of the disk sides, without any fwNES header>.fds (filesys.fname_sav %f.%M%x)
layout.content: the whole disk as the game left it: raw 65500-byte sides, no fwNES header (also when the ROM has one)
layout.written: on exit, and only if the game wrote to the disk; read back instead of the ROM on the next load

note: FDS BIOS disksys.rom in firmware/. Same disk as fceumm's .srm and FCEUX's .fds except one byte: Mednafen leaves 0xFF in the byte right after the last block it wrote (here the end of the side's used area, which is 0x00 in the ROM).
